48.original: I require your help to deliver sssomething of value.

49.original: A ssstrider I was pleased to call friend recently died in battle. I want to deliver a bracelet of his to his father.

50.original: If memory ssserves, they hailed from a village called Ala Gannha. I would go there by myssself, but I worry my appearance might frighten them.

51.original: That is why I would like you to accompany me. To show I come in peace. Now, let usss make our way there.

52.original: I have been waiting for you, ssstrider. I believe my friend sssaid his father was a ssstonemason who is fond of fishing.

53.original: I will wait here ssso I do not cause a commotion. Please bring my friend's father to me once you have located him.

54.original: I will wait here ssso I do not cause a commotion. Please bring my friend's father to me once you have located him.

56.original: You've come with an Ananta to deliver my son's bracelet? I had been wondering if anyone was going to bring me his former possessions.

57.original: I first heard of his passing a while ago from a Resistance fighter. Initially, I resented both the Empire <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> the Resistance equally for taking him from me.

58.original: However, now I have calmed down somewhat. I'm oh so proud of my boy. He did everything he could to free us from the Empire's clutches.

59.original: My thanks to you and this Ananta for bringing his bracelet back to me. I shall go collect it now.

60.original: My thanks to you and this Ananta for bringing my son's bracelet back to me.

62.original: Your ssson treated all races equally. He would often talk to me fondly of his family.

63.original: He sssaid you made that bracelet for him just before he left to join the Resissstance.

64.original: I was ssso moved by this I tried to make my own. Alasss, it did not go very well.

65.original: I'd no idea he spoke of me to his friends. Thank you for sharing that with me.

66.original: How about I make you a similar bracelet as a token of my gratitude?

67.original: I would like that very much.

68.original: In that case there is one thing I need your help finding first.

69.original: Ever since I lost my boy, I've been drinking a little more than usual and well...it seems I managed to misplace my hammer while I was somewhat inebriated.

70.original: Understood. I shall sssearch for this hammer.

71.original: Ssstrider, please lend me your help as well. It may not be easy to find.

72.original: Let me know if you find the ssstonemason's hammer.

73.original: My memory's so foggy I honestly have no idea where I lost it.

74.original: That's the one! Thank you so much. Now I can set about making another bracelet.

75.original: Would you mind telling me more about my son while I work?

76.original: It would be my pleasure. I have many fond memories of him.

77.original: Thank you for your help, ssstrider.
